improved_mark_of_the_wild.name: Improved Mark of the Wild
improved_mark_of_the_wild.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by [V1]%, and increases all of your total attributes by [V2]%.

natures_focus.name: Nature's Focus
natures_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting Healing Touch, Wrath, Entangling Roots, Cyclone, Nourish, Regrowth and Tranquility by [V1]%.

furor.name: Furor
furor.tooltipTemplate: Gives you [V1]% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear and Dire Bear Form, and you keep up to [V2] of your Energy when you shapeshift into Cat Form, and increases your total Intellect while in Moonkin form by [V3]%.

naturalist.name: Naturalist
naturalist.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by [V1] sec and increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by [V2]%.

subtlety.name: Subtlety
subtlety.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your restoration spells by [V1]% and reduces the chance your helpful spells, Moonfire, and Insect Swarm will be dispelled by [V2]%.

natural_shapeshifter.name: Natural Shapeshifter
natural_shapeshifter.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by [V1]%.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.tooltipTemplate: Allows [V1]% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting and causes your Enrage ability to instantly generate [V2] rage.

omen_of_clarity.name: Omen of Clarity
omen_of_clarity.tooltipTemplate: Each of the Druid's damage, healing spells and auto attacks has a chance of causing the caster to enter a Clearcasting state. The Clearcasting state reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next damage, healing spell or offensive ability by 100%.

master_shapeshifter.name: Master Shapeshifter
master_shapeshifter.tooltipTemplate:
Grants an effect which lasts while the Druid is within the respective shapeshift form.

Bear Form - Increases physical damage by [V1]%.

Cat Form - Increases critical strike chance by [V2]%.

Moonkin Form - Increases spell damage by [V3]%.

Tree of Life Form - Increases healing by [V4]%.

tranquil_spirit.name: Tranquil Spirit
tranquil_spirit.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch, Nourish and Tranquility spells by [V1]%.

improved_rejuvenation.name: Improved Rejuvenation
improved_rejuvenation.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by [V1]%.

natures_swiftness.name: Nature's Swiftness
natures_swiftness.tooltipTemplate: When activated, your next Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

gift_of_nature.name: Gift of Nature
gift_of_nature.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of all healing spells by [V1]%.

improved_tranquility.name: Improved Tranquility
improved_tranquility.tooltipTemplate: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by [V1]%, and reduces the cooldown by [V2]%.

empowered_touch.name: Empowered Touch
empowered_touch.tooltipTemplate: Your Healing Touch spell gains an additional [V1]% and your Nourish spell gains an additional [V2]% of your bonus healing effects.

natures_bounty.name: Nature's Bounty
natures_bounty.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth and Nourish spells by [V1]%.

swiftmend.name: Swiftmend
swiftmend.tooltipTemplate: Instantly heals a friendly target affected by your Rejuvenation or Regrowth for an amount equal to 12 sec. of Rejuvenation or 18 sec. of Regrowth.

natural_perfection.name: Natural Perfection
natural_perfection.tooltipTemplate: Your critical strike chance with all spells is increased by [V1]% and critical strikes against you give you the Natural Perfection effect reducing all damage taken by [V2]%.  Stacks up to 3 times.  Lasts 8 sec.

empowered_rejuvenation.name: Empowered Rejuvenation
empowered_rejuvenation.tooltipTemplate: The bonus healing effects of your healing over time spells is increased by [V1]%.

living_seed.name: Living Seed
living_seed.tooltipTemplate: When you critically heal your target with Swiftmend, Regrowth, Nourish or Healing Touch spell you have a [V1]% chance to plant a Living Seed on the target for 30% of the amount healed. The Living Seed will bloom when the target is next attacked. Lasts 15 sec.

revitalize.name: Revitalize
revitalize.tooltipTemplate: Your Rejuvenation and Wild Growth spells have a [V1]% chance to restore 8 Energy, 4 Rage, 1% Mana or 16 Runic Power per tick.

tree_of_life.name: Tree of Life
tree_of_life.tooltipTemplate:
Grants the ability to shapeshift into the Tree of Life. While in this form you increase healing received by 6% for all party and raid members within 100 yards, reduces the mana cost of your healing over time spells by 20% and you can only cast Restoration spells in addition to Innervate, Barkskin, Nature's Grasp and Thorns spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

improved_tree_of_life.name: Improved Tree of Life
improved_tree_of_life.tooltipTemplate: Increases your armor contribution from items while in Tree of Life Form by [V1]%, and increases your healing spell power by [V2]% of your spirit while in Tree of Life Form.

improved_barkskin.name: Improved Barkskin
improved_barkskin.tooltipTemplate: Grants [V1]% additional armor contribution from cloth and leather items while in Travel Form or while not shapeshifted, increases the damage reduction granted by your Barkskin spell by [V2]% and reduces the chance your Barkskin is dispelled by [V3]%.

gift_of_the_earthmother.name: Gift of the Earthmother
gift_of_the_earthmother.tooltipTemplate: Increases your total spell haste by [V1]% and reduces the global cooldown of your Lifebloom spell by [V2]%.

wild_growth.name: Wild Growth
wild_growth.tooltipTemplate: Heals up to 5 friendly party or raid members within 15 yards of the target for 686 over 7 sec. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as the Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

ferocity.name: Ferocity
ferocity.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Swipe, Thrash, Claw, Rake and Mangle abilities by [V1] Rage or Energy.

feral_aggression.name: Feral Aggression
feral_aggression.tooltipTemplate: Increases the attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by [V1]% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by [V2]%.

feral_instinct.name: Feral Instinct
feral_instinct.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Swipe and Thrash abilities by [V1]% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling.

savage_fury.name: Savage Fury
savage_fury.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Mangle (Cat), Mangle (Bear), and Maul abilities by [V1]%.

thick_hide.name: Thick Hide
thick_hide.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Armor contribution from cloth and leather items by [V1]%.

feral_swiftness.name: Feral Swiftness
feral_swiftness.tooltipTemplate: Increases your movement speed by [V1]% in Cat Form and increases your chance to dodge while in Cat Form, Bear Form and Dire Bear Form by [V2]%.

survival_instincts.name: Survival Instincts
survival_instincts.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec while in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form.  After the effect expires, the health is lost.

sharpened_claws.name: Sharpened Claws
sharpened_claws.tooltipTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear, Dire Bear or Cat Form by [V1]%.

shredding_attacks.name: Shredding Attacks
shredding_attacks.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the energy cost of your Shred ability by [V1] and the rage cost of your Lacerate ability by [V2].

predatory_strikes.name: Predatory Strikes
predatory_strikes.tooltipTemplate: Increases your melee attack power in Cat, Bear and Dire Bear Forms by [V1]% of your level and [V2]% of any attack power on your equipped weapon.  In addition, your finishing moves have a [V3]% chance per combo point to make your next Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. become an instant cast spell.

primal_fury.name: Primal Fury
primal_fury.tooltipTemplate: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage anytime you get a critical strike while in Bear and Dire Bear Form and your critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that add combo points  have a 100% chance to add an additional combo point.

primal_precision.name: Primal Precision
primal_precision.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Expertise by [V1], and you are refunded [V2]% of the energy cost of a finishing move if it fails to land.

brutal_impact.name: Brutal Impact
brutal_impact.tooltipTemplate: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by [V1] sec and decreases the cooldown of Bash by [V2] sec.

feral_charge.name: Feral Charge
feral_charge.tooltipTemplate:
Teaches Feral Charge (Bear) and Feral Charge (Cat).

Feral Charge (Bear) - Causes you to charge an enemy, immobilizing and interrupting any spell being cast for 4 sec. This ability can be used in Bear Form and Dire Bear Form. 15 second cooldown.

Feral Charge (Cat) - Causes you to leap behind an enemy, dazing them for 3 sec. 30 second cooldown.

nurturing_instinct.name: Nurturing Instinct
nurturing_instinct.tooltipTemplate: Increases your healing spells by up to [V1]% of your Agility, and increases healing done to you by [V2]% while in Cat form.

natural_reaction.name: Natural Reaction
natural_reaction.tooltipTemplate: Increases your dodge while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form by [V1]%, and you regenerate [V2] rage every time you dodge while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.

heart_of_the_wild.name: Heart of the Wild
heart_of_the_wild.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Intellect by [V1]%.  In addition, while in Bear or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by [V2]% and while in Cat Form your attack power is increased by [V3]%.

survival_of_the_fittest.name: Survival of the Fittest
survival_of_the_fittest.tooltipTemplate: Increases all attributes by [V1]%, reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by [V2]%, and increases your armor contribution from cloth and leather items in Bear Form and Dire Bear Form by [V3]%.

leader_of_the_pack.name: Leader of the Pack
leader_of_the_pack.tooltipTemplate: While in Cat, Bear or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases ranged and melee critical chance of all party and raid members within 100 yards by 5%.

improved_leader_of_the_pack.name: Improved Leader of the Pack
improved_leader_of_the_pack.tooltipTemplate: Your Leader of the Pack ability also causes affected targets to heal themselves for [V1]% of their total health when they critically hit with a melee or ranged attack.  The healing effect cannot occur more than once every 6 sec.  In addition, you gain [V2]% of your maximum mana when you benefit from this heal.

primal_tenacity.name: Primal Tenacity
primal_tenacity.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of fear effects by [V1]%, reduces all damage taken while stunned by [V2]% while in Cat Form.

protector_of_the_pack.name: Protector of the Pack
protector_of_the_pack.tooltipTemplate: Increases your attack power by [V1]% and reduces the damage you take by [V2]%, while in Bear or Dire Bear Form.

predatory_instincts.name: Predatory Instincts
predatory_instincts.tooltipTemplate: While in Cat Form increases your damage from physical critical strikes by [V1]% and reduces the damage taken from area of effect attacks by [V2]%.

infected_wounds.name: Infected Wounds
infected_wounds.tooltipTemplate: Your Shred, Maul, and Mangle attacks cause an Infected Wound in the target. The Infected Wound reduces the movement speed of the target by [V1]% and the attack speed by [V2]%. Lasts 12 sec.

king_of_the_jungle.name: King of the Jungle
king_of_the_jungle.tooltipTemplate: While using your Enrage ability in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, your damage is increased by [V1]%, and your Tiger's Fury ability also instantly restores [V2] energy.  In addition, the mana cost of Bear Form, Cat Form, and Dire Bear Form is reduced by [V3]%.

mangle.name: Mangle
mangle.tooltipTemplate: Mangle the target, inflicting damage and causing the target to take additional damage from bleed effects for 1 min.  This ability can be used in Cat Form or Dire Bear Form.

improved_mangle.name: Improved Mangle
improved_mangle.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Mangle (Bear) ability by [V1] sec., and reduces the energy cost of your Mangle (Cat) ability by [V2].

rend_and_tear.name: Rend and Tear
rend_and_tear.tooltipTemplate: Increases damage done by your Maul and Shred attacks on bleeding targets by [V1]%, and increases the critical strike chance of your Ferocious Bite ability on bleeding targets by [V2]%.

primal_gore.name: Primal Gore
primal_gore.tooltipTemplate: Grants the periodic damage from your Lacerate, Thrash, Rake and Rip abilities the ability to critically hit.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.tooltipTemplate:
When activated, this ability causes your Mangle (Bear) ability to hit up to 3 targets and have no cooldown, and reduces the energy cost of all your Cat Form abilities by 50%.  Lasts 15 sec.  You cannot use Tiger's Fury while Berserk is active.

Clears the effect of Fear and makes you immune to Fear for the duration.

starlight_wrath.name: Starlight Wrath
starlight_wrath.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge spells by [V1] sec.

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage and healing done by your periodic spell damage and healing effects by [V1]%.

moonglow.name: Moonglow
moonglow.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your Moonfire, Starfire, Starfall, Wrath, Healing Touch, Nourish, Regrowth and Rejuvenation spells by [V1]%.

natures_majesty.name: Nature's Majesty
natures_majesty.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wrath, Starfire, Starfall, Starsurge, Nourish and Healing Touch spells by [V1]%.

improved_moonfire.name: Improved Moonfire
improved_moonfire.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by [V1]%.

brambles.name: Brambles
brambles.tooltipTemplate: Damage from your Thorns and Entangling Roots increased by [V1]% and damage done by your Treants increased by [V2]%. In addition, damage from your Treants and attacks done to you while you have Barkskin active have a [V3]% chance to daze the target for 3 sec.

natures_grace.name: Nature's Grace
natures_grace.tooltipTemplate: All non-periodic spell criticals have a [V1]% chance to grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spell casting speed by 20% for 3 sec.

natures_splendor.name: Nature's Splendor
natures_splendor.tooltipTemplate: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm and Lifebloom spells by 2 sec.

natures_reach.name: Nature's Reach
natures_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Balance spells and Faerie Fire (Feral) ability by [V1]%, and reduces the threat generated by your Balance spells by [V2]%.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Starfire, Starfall, Starsurge, Moonfire, and Wrath spells by [V1]%.

celestial_focus.name: Celestial Focus
celestial_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Starfire, Starsurge, Hibernate and Hurricane by [V1]% and increases your total spell haste by [V2]%.

lunar_guidance.name: Lunar Guidance
lunar_guidance.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell power by [V1]% of your total Intellect.

insect_swarm.name: Insect Swarm
insect_swarm.tooltipTemplate: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit by 3% and causing 210 Nature damage over 14 sec.

improved_insect_swarm.name: Improved Insect Swarm
improved_insect_swarm.tooltipTemplate: Increases your damage done by your Wrath spell to targets afflicted by your Insect Swarm by [V1]%, and increases the critical strike chance of your Starfire spell by [V2]% on targets afflicted by your Moonfire spell.

dreamstate.name: Dreamstate
dreamstate.tooltipTemplate: Regenerate mana equal to [V1]% of your Intellect every 5 sec, even while casting.

moonfury.name: Moonfury
moonfury.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Starfire, Starsurge, Moonfire and Wrath spells by [V1]%.

balance_of_power.name: Balance of Power
balance_of_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with all spells by [V1]% and reduces your damage taken from all spells by [V2]%.

moonkin_form.name: Moonkin Form
moonkin_form.tooltipTemplate:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form.  While in this form the armor contribution from items is increased by 370%, damage taken while stunned is reduced by 15%, and all party and raid members within 100 yards have their spell critical chance increased by 5%. Any single target spell critical strikes in this form have a chance to instantly regenerate 3% of your total mana.  The Moonkin can not cast healing or resurrection spells while shapeshifted.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

improved_moonkin_form.name: Improved Moonkin Form
improved_moonkin_form.tooltipTemplate:
Requires Moonkin Form
Your Moonkin Aura also causes affected targets to gain [V1]% haste and you to gain [V2]% of your spirit as additional spell damage.

improved_faerie_fire.name: Improved Faerie Fire
improved_faerie_fire.tooltipTemplate: Your Faerie Fire spell also increases the chance the target will be hit by spell attacks by [V1]%, and increases the critical strike chance of your damage spells by [V2]% on targets afflicted by Faerie Fire.

owlkin_frenzy.name: Owlkin Frenzy
owlkin_frenzy.tooltipTemplate: Attacks done to you while in Moonkin form have a [V1]% chance to cause you to go into a Frenzy, increasing your damage by 10%, cause you to be immune to pushback while casting Balance spells and restore 2% base mana every 2 sec. Lasts 10 sec.

wrath_of_cenarius.name: Wrath of Cenarius
wrath_of_cenarius.tooltipTemplate: Your Starfire and Starsurge gains an additional [V1]% and your Wrath gains an additional [V2]% of your bonus damage effects.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.tooltipTemplate:
When you deal damage with Starfire, you have a [V1]% chance of increasing damage done by Wrath and Starsurge by 40%. 

When you deal damage with Wrath you have a [V2]% chance of increasing your critical strike chance with Starfire and Starsurge by 40%.

Each effect lasts 15 sec and each has a separate 30 sec cooldown.  Both effects cannot occur simultaneously.

typhoon.name: Typhoon
typhoon.tooltipTemplate: You summon a violent Typhoon that does 400 Nature damage when in contact with hostile targets, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

force_of_nature.name: Force of Nature
force_of_nature.tooltipTemplate: Summons 3 treants to attack enemy targets for 30 sec.

gale_winds.name: Gale Winds
gale_winds.tooltipTemplate: Increases damage done by your Hurricane and Typhoon spells by [V1]%, and increases the range of your Cyclone spell by [V2] yards.

earth_and_moon.name: Earth and Moon
earth_and_moon.tooltipTemplate: Increases your damage done by spells by [V1]%. In addition, your Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge spells have a 100% chance to apply the Earth and Moon effect, which increases spell damage taken by [V2]% and reduces resistances by [V3] for 12 sec.

starfall.name: Starfall
starfall.tooltipTemplate: You summon a flurry of stars from the sky on all targets within 30 yards of the caster, each dealing 145 to 167 Arcane damage. Also causes 26 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 5 yards of the enemy target. Maximum 20 stars. Lasts 10 sec.  Shapeshifting into an animal form or mounting cancels the effect. Any effect which causes you to lose control of your character will suppress the starfall effect.

enchants.name: Mass Entanglement
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Mass Entanglement. 
Mass Entanglement: Roots the target and all enemies within 8 yards in place for 8 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. 

Usable while shapeshifted.

enchants.name: Solar Beam
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Solar Beam. 
Solar Beam: You summon a beam of solar light, silencing all enemies under the beam while it is active. Solar Beam lasts for 6 sec.

enchants.name: Stampeding Roar
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Stampeding Roar. 
Stampeding Roar: You roar, increasing the movement speed of all party members within 20 yards by 60% for 6 sec. Does not break prowling.

enchants.name: Stonebark
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Stonebark 
Stonebark: Reduces all damage taken by 20%, increases resistance to Dispel mechanics by 50% and increases healing taken from Healing over Time effects by 40% from the caster for 8 sec.

enchants.name: Ursol's Vortex
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Ursol's Vortex. 
Ursol's Vortex: Conjures a vortex of wind for 8 sec around yourself, reducing the movement speed of all enemies within 5 yards by 30%. When an enemy leaves the vortex, winds will pull that enemy back to its center. Enemies can only get pulled from any vortex once every 8 seconds.

This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

enchants.name: Ambush Predator
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Rake or Rip has a 10% chance and Shred has a 20% chance to grant you Ambush Predator.
Ambush Predator: Your next Ravage can be cast outside of Prowl, has no positional requirement, costs 20 less energy and grants an additional combo point. Lasts 12 sec.

Additionally, Ravage will trigger your Mangle debuff.

enchants.name: Astral Alignment
enchants.tooltip: Casting Moonfire, Starfire or Starsurge on an enemy increases the damage they take from your Wrath by 10% for 10 sec. Casting Wrath on an affected target restores 5% base mana.

enchants.name: Astral Winds
enchants.tooltip: Targets released from your Cyclone or hit by your Typhoon take 50% reduced healing, fading over 8 sec seconds. In addition, the cast time of Cyclone is reduced by 0.3 seconds.

enchants.name: Bash and Thrash
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the threat generated by Bash significantly.

Using Bash grants you Enrage, empowers Mangle (Bear) to hit 2 additional nearby targets and causes you to generate extra threat on the target, scaling with your attack power for 8 sec.

enchants.name: Blooming Power
enchants.tooltip: Casting Swiftmend grants you Nature's Grace (if known) and increases the chance to critically heal with your next Healing Touch, Regrowth or Nourish by 50%.

enchants.name: Celestial Replenishment
enchants.tooltip: Triggering an Eclipse now restores 24% of your missing mana.

enchants.name: Clarity of the Mind
enchants.tooltip: Your Omen of Clarity talent has an additional 5% chance to trigger.

enchants.name: Counterpoise
enchants.tooltip: While above 50% rage, you gain 5% melee haste. While below 50% rage, you gain 3% melee critical strike chance.

enchants.name: Critical Cycles
enchants.tooltip: Casting Wrath or Starfire empowered by Eclipse increases the damage of your next Insect Swarm or Moonfire by 10% (5% against players), stacking up to 5 times. Casting Wrath or Starfire not empowered by Eclipse increases the duration of your Insect Swarm and Moonfire on the target by 8 seconds.

enchants.name: Cycles of Growth
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the periodic healing of Lifebloom by 50%, but reduces the healing of the Bloom by 50%.

Your Regrowth refreshes the duration of your Lifebloom on the target. This does not work if the target is already affected or recently affected by your Regrowth.

enchants.name: Elune's Fury
enchants.tooltip: Periodic damage from your Moonfire and Insect Swarm can now critically hit dealing 100% bonus damage. In addition, dealing damage with Starfall increases your critical strike chance by 15%, lasting for 1 second per target hit.

enchants.name: Everliving
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Swiftmend
While your Swiftmend is not on cooldown, healing with any direct or periodic spell reduces the cooldown of your next Swiftmend by -1.5 sec, stacking up to 10 times.

This effect can only occur once every 1 sec.

enchants.name: Faerie's Favor
enchants.tooltip: Using Faerie Fire (Feral) generates 20 energy and rage.

enchants.name: Ferocious Clarity
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the damage of Maul by 10%. In addition, increases the damage of Claw and Mangle (Cat) by 10% on targets affected by your Rake.

After killing an opponent that yields experience or honor you trigger Omen of Clarity.

enchants.name: Flourishing Nature
enchants.tooltip: When Rejuvenation triggers your Revitalize talent, the target has a chance to flourish. Casting Regrowth on a flourishing target will refresh your Druid heal over time effects on them and apply Rejuvenation to two additional allies within 30 yards.

enchants.name: Frenzied Growth
enchants.tooltip: Wild Growth healing is increased by 100% but its duration is reduced by 3 sec and it heals 2 less targets.

enchants.name: Frenzied Slashing
enchants.tooltip: Using Swipe (Bear) or Thrash increases your attack speed by 20% for 12 sec. This effect can only occur once every 10 seconds.

enchants.name: Graceful Resurgence
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Nature's Grace
Increases the damage of Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge on targets below 35% health by 25%.

Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor grants you Nature's Grace, increasing your cast speed by 20% for 6 seconds.

enchants.name: Languish
enchants.tooltip: Your Starfire, Wrath and Starsurge critical strikes causes the target to take an additional 8% of your spell's damage over 4 sec.

enchants.name: Localized Storm
Moon's Wrath
enchants.tooltip: Your Wrath and Starsurge have a 8% increased critical strike chance on targets affected by your Moonfire.

enchants.name: Nature's Abundance
enchants.tooltip:
Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch by 12%.

Your effective periodic heals with Rejuvenation or Regrowth restore 2% of your base mana. This effect can only occur once every second.

enchants.name: Nature's Synthesis
enchants.tooltip: Increases the healing done of Healing Touch and Nourish by 7% for each healing over time effect you have active on the target.

enchants.name: Omen of Doom
enchants.tooltip: Gaining Omen of Clarity increases your Arcane and Nature damage done by 10% for 6 seconds.

enchants.name: Omen of Fatality
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Omen of Clarity
Feral Bleed effects have a 35% chance of triggering Omen of Clarity and makes consuming Omen of Clarity increase your attack speed by 25% for 6 sec. 

While this buff is active, Omen of Clarity cannot trigger again.

enchants.name: One with the Forest
enchants.tooltip:
Your critical strikes while in Bear Form extends the duration of Barkskin by 1 second.

This effect can only occur once every second.

enchants.name: Pendulum
enchants.tooltip: Receive 3% spell haste while above 50% mana and 3% spell critical strike chance while below 50% mana.

enchants.name: Predator's Wrath: Combo
enchants.tooltip: Casting Wrath awards 2 combo points and increases the critical strike chance of your next direct damage Cat Form ability to by 25%.

enchants.name: Predator's Wrath: Focus
enchants.tooltip: Casting Wrath restores 20 energy. Wrath is unable to miss and costs no mana.

enchants.name: Primal Frenzy
enchants.tooltip: The damage of your Rake and Rip is increased by 1% for every 2% armor penetration you have. Dealing damage with Rip and Rake has a 15% chance to empower you, increasing armor penetration by 20% for 8 sec.

enchants.name: Razor Sweep
enchants.tooltip: Using Rake causes your next Claw or Mangle (Cat) to hit two additional nearby enemies and restore 10 energy per target.

enchants.name: Razor-sharp Claws
enchants.tooltip: Your Maul ability refreshes the duration of Rake on your target.

enchants.name: Relentless Laceration
enchants.tooltip: Using Lacerate causes you to ignore 2% of the target's armor and increases your chance to critically hit the target with melee attacks by 3%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 15 sec,

enchants.name: Savage Barricade
enchants.tooltip: Your Savage Defense can now store up to 2 charges.

enchants.name: Savage Frenzy
enchants.tooltip:
Each stack of your Feral Frenzy bleed increases the damage done of your abilities versus the target by 2%.

Every time you hit with Feral Frenzy the duration of your Savage Roar is increased by 6 sec.

enchants.name: Shifting Bark
enchants.tooltip: Barkskin reduces damage taken by an additional 10% and grants a 50% reduction to Silence and Interrupt effects while active.

enchants.name: Starcaller's Momentum
enchants.tooltip: Casting Wrath or Starfire 3 times in a row causes your next Starsurge to be instant cast. This effect can be stored up to 3 times. In addition, the cooldown of Starsurge is reduced by 2 sec.

enchants.name: Stellar Convergence
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Nature's Grace 
Dealing damage with Starsurge reduces the cooldown of your Starfall, Chosen of Elune and Touch of Elune by 0 sec and grants Nature's Grace.

enchants.name: Surging Eclipse
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Eclipse
Casting Starsurge while in an Eclipse phase will increase the damage of your next Wrath or Starfire by 30%, depending on the phase.

Empowered Wraths or Starfires have a 30% chance to reset the cooldown of Starsurge.

enchants.name: Symbiotic Nature
enchants.tooltip: The healing of Regrowth is increased by 20% on targets affected by your Rejuvenation and the healing of Rejuvenation is increased by 20% on targets affected by your Regrowth.

enchants.name: TIMBERRR
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Force of Nature
Increases the duration of your Treants summoned from Force of Nature by 100%.

enchants.name: Tiger's Instinct
enchants.tooltip: Using Claw, Mangle (Cat), or Swipe (Cat) reduces the cooldown of Tiger's Fury by 2 sec.

enchants.name: Touch of Elune
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Touch of Elune. 
Touch of Elune: Place the Touch of Elune on an enemy. All damage dealt by your Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge spells to other targets will damage the enemy marked by your Touch of Elune. Lasts for 15 sec.

While Touch of Elune is active on any enemy, all damage you deal to any target is increased by 10%.

enchants.name: Ursoc's Rage
enchants.tooltip: Using Maul, Swipe (Bear), Mangle (Bear) or Lacerate reduces the cooldown of Enrage by 1.5 seconds. Enrage also increases your melee critical strike chance by 10%.

enchants.name: Verdant Insight
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the healing of Lifebloom by 15%.

Periodic healing from Lifebloom has a 3% chance per stack to trigger Omen of Clarity.

enchants.name: Viscera
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Mangle
Your Lacerate, Thrash and auto attacks have a 20% chance of resetting the cooldown of Mangle.

Increase the critical strike chance of your Mangle (Bear) by 25%.

enchants.name: Balance Mastery
enchants.tooltip:
Eclipse (Lunar) now increases your damage done with all spells by 5%.

Eclipse (Solar) now increases your critical strike chance with all spells by 5%.

enchants.name: Carnage Incarnate
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Carnage Incarnate. 
Carnage Incarnate: Encase yourself in blood and bones, reducing physical damage taken by 10% and dealing ${103*0.99)+(0*0.09} physical damage to nearby enemies and healing you for ${82*0.99)+(0*0.045} every second. Lasts for 8 sec.

enchants.name: Celestial Power
enchants.tooltip:
Your Starfire applies Star's Fury on targets not affected by your Moonfire. This effect does not stack with Moonfire.

Your Wrath applies Nature's Wrath on targets not affected by your Insect Swarm. This effect does not stack with Insect Swarm.
Star's Fury: Increases the damage the target takes from your Starfire and Starsurge by 5%, stacking up to 3 times. Lasts 20 sec.
Nature's Wrath: Increases the damage the target takes from your Wrath and Starsurge by 5%, stacking up to 3 times. Lasts 20 sec.

enchants.name: Chosen of Elune
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Eclipse
Eclipse (Solar) increase your critical strike rating by 15% of your Spirit, and your Eclipse (Lunar) increase your haste rating by 15% of your Spirit. 

Teaches you: Chosen of Elune. 
Chosen of Elune: Resets the cooldown of Starsurge and reduces its cooldown by 50% for 15 sec. Also activates both Lunar Eclipse and Solar Eclipse. This does not incur a cooldown on the Eclipse effects.

enchants.name: Deranged Druid
enchants.tooltip: Your damaging Druid spell casts and Feral abilities have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Druid spell for free.

enchants.name: Efflorescence
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Efflorescence
Efflorescence: Grows a healing blossom at the target location, increasing healing taken by 15% and restoring 106.64 health to allies within 10 yards every 2 sec for 10 sec. Also applies Rejuvenation to up to 5 targets.

enchants.name: Feral Frenzy
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Feral Frenzy. 
Feral Frenzy: Requires Cat Form

Unleash a furious frenzy, clawing your target 5 times over 1.5 seconds for 50% weapon damage and applying a bleed which stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 10 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

enchants.name: Feral Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage of your Rake, Rip and Ferocious Bite by 6% and their critical strike damage by an additional 6%.

enchants.name: Flow of Life
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Tranquility
Transforms Tranquility into Flow of Life.

This ability scales from your Tranqulity modifiers.
Flow of Life: Heals the 5 lowest health nearby party or raid members for ${(146+0.88)+(0*0.0.085085)} Every 1 seconds for 8 sec seconds and restores 1 seconds of your active heal over Time effects on allies healed.

enchants.name: Fury Unleashed
enchants.tooltip:
Your Mangle has 20% increased critical strike chance and extends the duration of Rip on your target by 1 second. 

Using Tiger’s Fury unleashes a ferocious swipe on up to 5 enemies in front of you. Each enemy hit reduces the cooldown of Tiger’s Fury by 2 seconds.

enchants.name: Guardian Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your maximum health by 4% and your chance to critically strike by 4%.

enchants.name: Guardians of the Grove
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Force of Nature
Your Treants now heal allies below 90% health using Rejuvenation and Regrowth, but no longer deals damage and their health is reduced by 50%.

enchants.name: Incarnation: King of the Jungle
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Incarnation: King of the Jungle. 
Incarnation: King of the Jungle: Your Cat Form is empowered for 15 sec.

Mangle (Cat) and Shred causes an additional swiping attack, dealing damage to enemies within 5 yards.

Ferocious Bite extends Rip to its full duration.

enchants.name: Ironfur
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Ironfur. 
Ironfur: 3 Charges
10 sec recharge
Grants 10 Rage and reduces damage taken by 4% plus an additional 4% per stack. Lasts 6 seconds. Stacks up to 3.

enchants.name: Nature's Fervor
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Infected Wounds
Your Thrash ability now has a 9 second cooldown grants Nature's Fervor.
Nature's Fervor: Faerie Fire grants 8% increased agility for 10 seconds. 

Swipe generates double threat and procs the last rank of Infected Wounds (if known). 

Growl generates significant threat, applies Demoralizing Roar and only triggers a 1 second cooldown.

enchants.name: Overflow
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Nourish or Regrowth makes your next Healing Touch guaranteed to trigger Living Seed and reduces its cast time and mana cost by 20%, stacking up to 3. 

Each stack also makes Healing Touch heal an extra ally for 30% of the amount healed.

enchants.name: Predator's Wrath: Wrathful Strikes
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Predatory Strikes
Predator’s Swiftness now allows you to cast Wrath while in Cat Form, dealing additional damage equal to 30% of your Attack Power.

Casting Wrath in this way causes your direct physical damaging abilities to trigger additional damage. This bonus damage is increased by 5% per stack, stacks 10 times, lasts 15 seconds.

enchants.name: Restoration Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the effectiveness of your heal over time effects by 4% and reduces the mana cost of Regrowth, Healing Touch and Nourish by 8%.

enchants.name: Spirit of the Forest
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Spirit of the Forest. 
Spirit of the Forest: Imbues you with the Spirit of the Forest for 20 sec, reducing the cooldown of Wild Growth by 50%, the mana cost of Lifebloom by 50%, increasing Rejuvenation duration by 9 sec, and causing your Rejuvenation to also instantly heal your ally for ${152*0.99)+(0*0.585)}.

enchants.name: Sunfire
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Sunfire. 

The periodic damage from Sunfire can critically strike and benefits from spell haste.

Sunfire: Burns your target and 4 additional targets within 8 yards, dealing 171 to 205 Firestorm damage and 370 additional damage over 18 sec.

Sunfire increases the periodic damage from Moonfire and Insect Swarm by 20% plus 10% per target hit for its duration.

enchants.name: Brambles
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Damage from your Thorns and Entangling Roots increased by 75% and damage done by your Treants increased by 15%. In addition, damage from your Treants and attacks done to you while you have Barkskin active have a 15% chance to daze the target for 3 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Brambles Talent.

enchants.name: Celestial Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Starfire, Starsurge, Hibernate and Hurricane by 70% and increases your total spell haste by 3%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Celestial Focus Talent.

enchants.name: Earthen Power Well
enchants.tooltip: Casting damaging Nature spells has a 15% chance to make your next non-Nature spell have no cost.

enchants.name: Feral Aggression
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the attack power reduction of your Demoralizing Roar by 40% and the damage caused by your Ferocious Bite by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Feral Aggression Talent.

enchants.name: Feral Charge
Feral Instinct
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage done by your Swipe ability by 30% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Feral Instinct Talent.

enchants.name: Feral Swiftness
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your movement speed by 30% in Cat Form and increases your chance to dodge while in Cat Form, Bear Form and Dire Bear Form by 4%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Feral Swiftness Talent.

enchants.name: Ferocity
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cost of your Maul, Swipe, Claw, Rake and Mangle abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Ferocity Talent.

enchants.name: Furor
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives you 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear and Dire Bear Form, and you keep up to 100 of your Energy when you shapeshift into Cat Form, and increases your total Intellect while in Moonkin form by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Furor Talent.

enchants.name: Genesis
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage and healing done by your periodic spell damage and healing effects by 5%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Genesis Talent.

enchants.name: Glyph of Barkskin
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 25% while Barkskin is active.

enchants.name: Glyph of Berserk
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Berserk by 5 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Claw
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the energy cost of your Claw ability by 5.

enchants.name: Glyph of Entangling Roots
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage your Entangling Roots victims can take before the Entangling Roots automatically breaks by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Focus
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by Starfall by 10%, decreases its radius by 30%, and increases its duration by 2 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Frenzied Regeneration
enchants.tooltip: While Frenzied Regeneration is active, healing effects on you are 20% more powerful.

enchants.name: Glyph of Healing Touch
enchants.tooltip: Decreases the cast time of Healing Touch by -1.25 sec, the mana cost by 20%, and the amount healed by 50%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Hurricane
enchants.tooltip: Your Hurricane ability also slows the movement speed of its victims by 20%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Innervate
enchants.tooltip: Innervate now grants the caster 45% of his base mana pool over 10 sec in addition to the normal effects of Innervate.

enchants.name: Glyph of Insect Swarm
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage of your Insect Swarm ability by 30%, but it no longer affects your victim's chance to hit.

enchants.name: Glyph of Lifebloom
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of Lifebloom by 1 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Mangle
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by Mangle by 10%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Maul
enchants.tooltip: Your Maul ability hits 1 additional target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Monsoon
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of your Typhoon spell by -3 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Moonfire
enchants.tooltip: Increases the periodic damage of your Moonfire ability by 75%, but initial damage is decreased by 90%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Nourish
enchants.tooltip: Your Nourish heals an additional 6% for each of your heal over time effects present on the target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Rake
enchants.tooltip: Your Rake deals 20% more damage and prevents targets from fleeing.

enchants.name: Glyph of Rapid Rejuvenation
enchants.tooltip: Your haste now reduces the time between the periodic healing ticks of your Rejuvenation spell.

enchants.name: Glyph of Rebirth
enchants.tooltip: Players resurrected by Rebirth are returned to life with 100% health.

enchants.name: Glyph of Regrowth
enchants.tooltip: Increases the healing and critical strike chance of your Regrowth spell by 20% if your Regrowth effect is still active on the target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Rejuvenation
enchants.tooltip: While your Rejuvenation targets are below 50% health, you will heal them for an additional 50% health.

enchants.name: Glyph of Rip
enchants.tooltip: Increases the duration of your Rip ability by 4 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Savage Roar
enchants.tooltip: Your Savage Roar ability grants an additional 6% bonus damage done.

enchants.name: Glyph of Shred
enchants.tooltip: Each time you Shred, the duration of your Rip on the target is extended 2 sec, up to a maximum of 6 sec.

enchants.name: Glyph of Starfall
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of Starfall by -30 sec and causes it to only hit enemies in combat.

enchants.name: Glyph of Starfire
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Starfire by 25%.

enchants.name: Glyph of Survival Instincts
enchants.tooltip: Your Survival Instincts ability grants an additional 15% of your maximum health.

enchants.name: Glyph of Swiftmend
enchants.tooltip: Swiftmend refreshes the duration of your Rejuvenation and Regrowth on the target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Typhoon
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cost of your Typhoon spell by 8% and increases its radius by 10 yards, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

enchants.name: Glyph of Wild Growth
enchants.tooltip: Wild Growth can affect 1 additional target.

enchants.name: Glyph of Wrath
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike chance of Wrath by 15%, but increases its cast time by 0.15 sec.

enchants.name: Improved Mark of the Wild
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effects of your Mark of the Wild and Gift of the Wild spells by 40%, and increases all of your total attributes by 2%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Mark of the Wild Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Moonfire
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Moonfire Talent.

enchants.name: Improved Rejuvenation
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 15%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Improved Rejuvenation Talent.

enchants.name: Intensity
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Allows 40% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting and causes your Enrage ability to instantly generate 15 rage.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Intensity Talent.

enchants.name: Master Shapeshifter
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Grants an effect which lasts while the Druid is within the respective shapeshift form.

Bear Form - Increases physical damage by 4%.

Cat Form - Increases critical strike chance by 4%.

Moonkin Form - Increases spell damage by 4%.

Tree of Life Form - Increases healing by 4%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Master Shapeshifter Talent.

enchants.name: Moonglow
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the Mana cost of your Moonfire, Starfire, Starfall, Wrath, Healing Touch, Nourish, Regrowth and Rejuvenation spells by 12%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Moonglow Talent.

enchants.name: Natural Shapeshifter
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Natural Shapeshifter Talent.

enchants.name: Naturalist
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch spell by 0.5 sec and increases the damage you deal with physical attacks in all forms by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Naturalist Talent.

enchants.name: Nature's Focus
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks  while casting Healing Touch, Wrath, Entangling Roots, Cyclone, Nourish, Regrowth and Tranquility by 70%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Nature's Focus Talent.

enchants.name: Nature's Grace
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
All non-periodic spell criticals have a 100% chance to grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spell casting speed by 20% for 3 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Nature's Grace Talent.

enchants.name: Nature's Majesty
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike chance of your Wrath, Starfire, Starfall, Nourish and Healing Touch spells by 4%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Nature's Majesty Talent.

enchants.name: Nature's Reach
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the range of your Balance spells and Faerie Fire (Feral) ability by 20%, and reduces the threat generated by your Balance spells by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Nature's Reach Talent.

enchants.name: Nature's Splendor
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm and Lifebloom spells by 2 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Nature's Splendor Talent.

enchants.name: Omen of Clarity
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Each of the Druid's damage, healing spells and auto attacks has a chance of causing the caster to enter a Clearcasting state.  The Clearcasting state reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next damage, healing spell or offensive ability by 100%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Omen of Clarity Talent.

enchants.name: Predatory Strikes
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your melee attack power in Cat, Bear and Dire Bear Forms by 150% of your level and 20% of any attack power on your equipped weapon.  In addition, your finishing moves have a 20% chance per combo point to make your next Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. become an instant cast spell.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Predatory Strikes Talent.

enchants.name: Primal Fury
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage anytime you get a critical strike while in Bear and Dire Bear Form and your critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that add combo points  have a 100% chance to add an additional combo point.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Primal Fury Talent.

enchants.name: Primal Precision
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your Expertise by 10 and you are refunded 80% of the energy cost of a finishing move if it fails to land.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Primal Precision Talent.

enchants.name: Savage Fury
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Mangle (Cat), Mangle (Bear), and Maul abilities by 20%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Savage Fury Talent.

enchants.name: Sharpened Claws
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear, Dire Bear or Cat Form by 9%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Sharpened Claws Talent.

enchants.name: Shredding Attacks
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the energy cost of your Shred ability by 18 and the rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 2.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Shredding Attacks Talent.

enchants.name: Starlight Wrath
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the cast time of your Wrath, Starfire and Starsurge spells by 0.5 sec.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Starlight Wrath Talent.

enchants.name: Subtlety
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the threat generated by your restoration spells by 30% and reduces the chance your helpful spells, Moonfire, and Insect Swarm will be dispelled by 30%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Subtlety Talent.

enchants.name: Thick Hide
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases your Armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Thick Hide Talent.

enchants.name: Tranquil Spirit
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch, Nourish and Tranquility spells by 10%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Tranquil Spirit Talent.

enchants.name: Vengeance
enchants.tooltip:
Crossover Talent
Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Starfire, Starfall, Starsurge, Moonfire, and Wrath spells by 100%.

This Mystic Enchant does not stack with the Vengeance Talent.

abilities.name: Barkskin
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The druid's skin becomes as tough as bark.  All damage taken is reduced by 20%.  While protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays.  This spell is usable while stunned, frozen, incapacitated, feared or asleep.  Usable in all forms.  Lasts 12 sec.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Tosses the enemy target into the air, preventing all action but making them invulnerable for up to 6 sec.  Only one target can be affected by your Cyclone at a time.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Roots the target in place and causes 270 Nature damage over 27 sec.  Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Faerie Fire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Decrease the armor of the target by 5% for 5 min.  While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

abilities.name: Force of Nature
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons 3 treants to attack enemy targets for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Hibernate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec.  Any damage will awaken the target.  Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time.  Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

abilities.name: Hurricane
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 190 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 20%.  Lasts 10 sec.  Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes the target to regenerate mana equal to 225% of the casting Druid's base mana pool over 10 sec.

abilities.name: Insect Swarm
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit by 3% and causing 210 Nature damage over 14 sec.

abilities.name: Moonfire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Burns the enemy for 256 to 291 Arcane damage and then an additional 508 Arcane damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.tooltipTemplate: While active, any time an enemy strikes the caster they have a 100% chance to become afflicted by Entangling Roots (Rank 6).  3 charges.  Lasts 45 sec.

abilities.name: Poison Rain
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Deals 460 Nature damage and applies Catalyst to 10 nearby enemies every 1 seconds for 4 sec while channeled.

Catalyst: Increases the damage of the casters Instant Poison and Deadly Poison by 4%. Stacks 4 times. Lasts for 12 seconds.

abilities.name: Soothe Animal
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards.  Only affects Beast and Dragonkin targets level 70 or lower.  Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Starfall
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You summon a flurry of stars from the sky on all targets within 30 yards of the caster, each dealing 145 to 167 Arcane damage. Also causes 26 Arcane damage to all other enemies within 5 yards of the enemy target. Maximum 20 stars. Lasts 10 sec.  Shapeshifting into an animal form or mounting cancels the effect. Any effect which causes you to lose control of your character will suppress the starfall effect.

abilities.name: Starfire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 693 to 817 Arcane damage to the target.

abilities.name: Starsurge
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Deals 707 to 866 Astral damage to the target.

abilities.name: Teleport: Moonglade
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

abilities.name: Thorns
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 18 Nature damage to attackers when hit.  Lasts 30 min.

abilities.name: Typhoon
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You summon a violent Typhoon that does 400 Nature damage when in contact with hostile targets, knocking them back and dazing them for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Wrath
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes 318 to 356 Nature damage to the target.

abilities.name: Aquatic Form
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Shapeshift into aquatic form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Stuns the target for 4 sec and interrupts non-player spellcasting for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Bear Form
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Shapeshift into dire bear form, increasing melee attack power by 200, armor contribution from cloth and leather items by 370%, and Stamina by 25%.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
When activated, this ability causes your Mangle (Bear) ability to hit up to 3 targets and have no cooldown, and reduces the energy cost of all your Cat Form abilities by 50%.  Lasts 15 sec.  You cannot use Tiger's Fury while Berserk is active.

Clears the effect of Fear and makes you immune to Fear for the duration.

abilities.name: Cat Form
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Shapeshift into cat form, increasing melee attack power by 120 plus Agility.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Challenging Roar
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Forces all nearby enemies within 10 yards to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.(This spell cannot miss)

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Claw the enemy, causing 138 additional damage.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Cower
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases movement speed by 60% while in Cat Form for 15 sec.  Does not break prowling.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Roar
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 146.  Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Generates 20 rage, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form.

abilities.name: Faerie Fire (Feral)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Decrease the armor of the target by 5% for 5 min.  While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.  Deals 1 damage and additional threat when used in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form.

abilities.name: Feral Charge
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Teaches Feral Charge (Bear) and Feral Charge (Cat).

Feral Charge (Bear) - Causes you to charge an enemy, immobilizing and interrupting any spell being cast for 4 sec. This ability can be used in Bear Form and Dire Bear Form. 15 second cooldown.

Feral Charge (Cat) - Causes you to leap behind an enemy, dazing them for 3 sec. 30 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Ferocious Bite
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy (up to a maximum of 30 extra energy) into 2.1 additional damage.  Damage is increased by your attack power.
   1 point  : 218.7-278.7 damage
   2 points: 380.4-440.4 damage
   3 points: 542.1-602.1 damage
   4 points: 703.8-763.8 damage
   5 points: 865.5-925.5 damage

abilities.name: Flight Form
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Shapeshift into flight form, increasing movement speed by $1133948s2% and allowing you to fly.  Cannot use in combat.  Can only use this form in Outland or Northrend.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Frenzied Regeneration
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Converts up to 10 rage per second into health for 10 sec.  Each point of rage is converted into 0.3% of max health.

abilities.name: Frenzied Swipe
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Swipe at your target and nearby enemies for 300% weapon damage.

This sends your tamed beast into a frenzy, causing its auto attacks to strike up to 5 nearby enemies for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Growl
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

This spell can not miss.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Lacerates the enemy target, dealing 50 damage and making them bleed for 180 damage over 15 sec and causing a high amount of threat.  Damage increased by attack power.  This effect stacks up to 3 times on the same target.

abilities.name: Maim
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that causes damage and stuns the target.  Non-player victim spellcasting is also interrupted for 3 sec.  Causes more damage and lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 129-129 damage, 1 sec
   2 points: 213-213 damage, 2 sec
   3 points: 297-297 damage, 3 sec
   4 points: 381-381 damage, 4 sec
   5 points: 465-465 damage, 5 sec

abilities.name: Mangle
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Mangle the target, inflicting damage and causing the target to take additional damage from bleed effects for 1 min.  This ability can be used in Cat Form or Dire Bear Form.

abilities.name: Mangle (Bear)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Mangle the target for 124% normal damage plus 140.12 and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from bleed effects for 1 min.

abilities.name: Mangle (Cat)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Mangle the target for 200% normal damage plus 256 and causes the target to take 30% additional damage from bleed effects for 1 min.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.tooltipTemplate: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 186 and causes a high amount of threat.  Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Maul damage.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Pounce, stunning the target for 3 sec and causing 450 damage over 18 sec.  Must be prowling.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%.  Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Rake the target for 73 bleed damage and an additional 342 damage over 9 sec.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Ravage the target, causing 500% damage plus 635 to the target.  Must be prowling and behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Rip
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point and by your attack power:
   1 point: 300 damage over 12 sec.
   2 points: 486 damage over 12 sec.
   3 points: 672 damage over 12 sec.
   4 points: 858 damage over 12 sec.
   5 points: 1044 damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Savage Roar
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Finishing move that increases physical damage done by 30%.  Only useable while in Cat Form.  Lasts longer per combo point:
   1 point  : 14 seconds
   2 points: 19 seconds
   3 points: 24 seconds
   4 points: 29 seconds
   5 points: 34 seconds

abilities.name: Shred
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Shred the target, causing 225% damage plus 180 to the target.  Must be behind the target.  Awards 1 combo point.  Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Shred damage.

abilities.name: Survival Instincts
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec while in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form.  After the effect expires, the health is lost.

abilities.name: Swipe (Bear)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 62 damage.  Damage increased by attack power.

abilities.name: Swipe (Cat)
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Swipe nearby enemies, inflicting 250% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Deals 67 damage, and causes all targets within 8 yards to bleed for 15 damage over 8 sec. Effects which increase Bleed damage also increase Thrash damage.

abilities.name: Tiger's Fury
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases damage done by 40 for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap.  Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

abilities.name: Travel Form
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Shapeshift into travel form, increasing movement speed by 40%.  Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.  Only useable outdoors.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Abolish Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 3 seconds for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

abilities.name: Flow of Life
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals the 5 lowest health nearby party or raid members for ${(439+1.48)+(0*0.0.085085)} Every 1 seconds for 8 sec seconds and restores 1 seconds of your active heal over Time effects on allies healed.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 1400.

abilities.name: Lifebloom
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals the target for 175 over 7 sec.  When Lifebloom completes its duration or is dispelled, the target instantly heals themself for 367 and the Druid regains half the cost of the spell.  This effect can stack up to 3 times on the same target.

abilities.name: Mark of the Wild
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the friendly target's armor by 285, all attributes by 12 and all resistances by 20 for 30 min.

abilities.name: Nourish
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 573. Heals for an additional 30% if you have a Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Lifebloom, or Wild Growth effect active on the target.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 2200 health and 2800 mana.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 723 and another 770 over 21 sec.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals the target for 760 over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Remove Curse
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Dispels 1 Curse from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 600 health and 800 mana.  Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Forest
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Imbues you with the Spirit of the Forest for 20 sec, reducing the cooldown of Wild Growth by 50%, the mana cost of Lifebloom by 50%, increasing Rejuvenation duration by 9 sec, and causing your Rejuvenation to also instantly heal your ally for ${152*0.99)+(0*0.585)}.

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals all nearby group members for 1097 every 2 seconds for 8 sec.  Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Tree of Life
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Grants the ability to shapeshift into the Tree of Life. While in this form you increase healing received by 6% for all party and raid members within 100 yards, reduces the mana cost of your healing over time spells by 20% and you can only cast Restoration spells in addition to Innervate, Barkskin, Nature's Grasp and Thorns spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals up to 5 friendly party or raid members within 15 yards of the target for 686 over 7 sec. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as the Wild Growth reaches its full duration.
